verdict.label: benign
verdict.description: Postinstall script validates native binary compatibility and installs fallback wasm if needed.

behaviors.behavior: Reads package.json to check for @swc/wasm dependency
behaviors.analysis: Line 69 reads package.json to check if @swc/wasm is already installed. This is a legitimate dependency validation step.
behaviors.impact: Legitimate: Verifies native binary compatibility before installation.

behaviors.behavior: Executes npm install with --no-save and --prefer-offline flags
behaviors.technique: Inspect postinstall.js line 125: child_process.execSync(`npm install --no-save --loglevel=error --prefer-offline --no-audit --progress=false @swc/wasm@${version}`, { cwd: installDir, stdio: "pipe", env });
behaviors.analysis: Line 125 executes npm install with explicit flags to avoid optional dependencies. This is a legitimate installation command.
behaviors.impact: Legitimate: Forces system npm to resolve @swc/wasm dependency.

behaviors.technique: Inspect postinstall.js line 134: fs.unlinkSync(entryPath); in removeRecursive function.
behaviors.analysis: Line 134 removes node_modules directory after installation. This is a legitimate cleanup step.
behaviors.impact: Legitimate: Cleans up temporary installation artifacts.

behaviors.behavior: Checks if native binding binary works by running ldd
behaviors.technique: Inspect postinstall.js line 52: const triple = binding.getTargetTriple ? binding.getTargetTriple() : binding.parseSync("console.log()", Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ syntax: "ecmascript" }))));
behaviors.analysis: Line 52 checks if native binding binary works by running ldd. This is a legitimate compatibility check.
behaviors.impact: Legitimate: Verifies native binary compatibility before installation.

behaviors.technique: Inspect postinstall.js line 54: if (!!process.env["SWC_BINARY_PATH"]) { console.warn(`@swc/core could not resolve native bindings installation, but found manual override config SWC_BINARY_PATH specified. Skipping remaning validation.`); return; }
behaviors.analysis: Line 54 checks for manual override config. This is a legitimate validation step that skips if no override exists.
behaviors.impact: Legitimate: Validates installation configuration before proceeding.

remediation: Review postinstall.js line 125 to ensure npm install flags are correct and do not bypass native binary checks.
Verify SWC_BINARY_PATH environment variable is properly configured if manual override is needed.
Ensure removeRecursive function handles directory cleanup safely after installation.

reasons: Install path not fully reviewed; human review required
